body.title: WSL shared-db audit requires npx supabase not Windows global shim
body.summary: On CG-RYZEN9DESK WSL, bare `supabase` resolves to /mnt/c/.../npm/supabase without linux-x64 binary; use npx --yes supabase or scripts/lib/supabase-cli-spawn.mjs.
body.canonicalQuestion: Why does cg:shared-db:audit fail on WSL with No matching Supabase CLI binary?
alternateQuestions: What is the canonical Supabase CLI invocation for CG-AppBuilder-MCP on Linux?
